title: loliolum subulatum
intro: Loliolum subulatum, commonly known as Loliolum, is a type of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and skin infections. The health benefits of Loliolum subulatum include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in the healing process and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties.
